name: p99_c0_conditional_confusion_specialist_lower_bound
hypothesis: Global Skeleton/IMU experts may be weak because they must solve unrelated classes. Conditional specialists can reveal whether the modalities carry strong local ranking knowledge before any routing mechanism is considered.
calibration: inner-leave-one-user-out temperature restricted to the known candidate group
shuffle: within-held-user candidate rows; missing IMU remains uniform
scope: conditional lower bound only; true group membership is not available to a deployment router
h2_policy: Only a specialist passing the frozen H1 gate may receive one conditional H2 confirmation; no router is designed in C0.
